scope: Proposition 3.6 (Wall and vertex coordinates) of the manuscript “A boundary-only obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding” (preprints/A-boundary-only-obstruction-to-four-dimensional-disk-embedding-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cb5bb77f6a673a3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are wall charts with parameters (ai, yi) ∈ C3 ⊕ Cni , vertex parameters (a, t) ∈ C3d ⊕ CD, a vertex defect ideal r ⊂ C[[a, t]], and algebraic maps ι+ i (a, t) = (ai, Y + i (a, t)), ι− i (a, t) = (0, Y − i (a, t)), (3.4) with the following properties. The maps give the actual based restrictions of the flat vertex family modulo r. The ai are algebraic group coordinates for the first-slope holonomy, centered at the identity. The two maps t 7−→ Y (0, t), t 7−→ σY (0, t), Y = (Y + i , Y − i )d i=1, have injective and complementary tangent images in Y.
